onset.Description: Seconds from the start of the HFA time series (= song onset).

duration.Description: Duration of the song (190.72 s) or of the run of consecutive outlier samples.

trial_type.Description: Row type: the song, or a run of outlier samples on one channel.

Levels.song: The whole song (HFA is aligned to it by the authors)
Levels.outlier_samples: Consecutive samples of one channel marked true in the authors' artifacts matrix (HFA exceeding 7 SD); exact reconstruction of that matrix

channel.Description: Channel the outlier run belongs to.
